speaker: Doctor
text: Hello, I'm Dr. Agent. Can you describe the appearance of the rash and tell me if it is itchy or painful? Also, has the rash appeared in a specific pattern or spread from a central point?

speaker: Patient
text: 11-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing a mildly pruritic rash on her trunk and extremities for 2 days. One week ago, she developed symptoms of low-grade fever, rhinorrhea, and headache. A facial rash appeared 4 days later, sparing the perioral area.

speaker: Doctor
text:
The presence of a facial rash sparing the perioral area in a child with preceding flu-like symptoms is highly suggestive of Erythema Infectiosum, also known as Fifth Disease. I will now confirm the diagnosis.

DIAGNOSIS READY: Erythema Infectiosum (Fifth Disease)
